scope: Optional local moments; contributor missions and gym rewards remain separate.

dogpatch.request: Could you check the bike rack for a little pump? I lent it out, and now everybody has a flat.
dogpatch.found: You free the pump from a tangle of locks.
dogpatch.thanks: There it is. Keep the repair kit. You did the annoying part.
dogpatch.look: A bike pump is wedged behind the rack.

potrero_hill.request: I dropped a route sketch by the streetlight. Can you check? My phone keeps suggesting more stairs.
potrero_hill.found: You straighten the folded route sketch.
potrero_hill.thanks: Perfect. Now I can get home without accidentally doing leg day twice.
potrero_hill.look: A folded sketch shows a very determined route around the steep streets.

mission.found: A planter holds a handwritten invitation: Bring something you made. Bad drawings count. A little care kit sits beside it.
mission.thanks: The invitation has fresh doodles in the margin. Someone drew the planter, too.
mission.look: The community invitation is still here.

castro.request: Could you look by the bench for my film list? I spent an hour choosing one and then lost the whole list.
castro.found: You find a list with every film crossed out except one.
castro.thanks: Thank you. Apparently I chose a film last week. This is a personal breakthrough.
castro.look: A film list peeks out from beneath a cup.

outer_sunset.request: Did you see a wax tin by the bench? Mine has a ridiculous cloud sticker. Hard to miss, in theory.
outer_sunset.found: The tin has the cloud sticker.
outer_sunset.thanks: Yep, that one. Keep the extra supply. I already have enough stuff in my pockets.
outer_sunset.look: A small tin with a cloud sticker sits under the bench.

golden_gate_park.found: The windmill once helped bring water to the park. A small trail kit rests beside a note: Take one if you need it.
golden_gate_park.thanks: The note is weighted down with a stone. Someone has written Thank you underneath.
golden_gate_park.look: A windmill rises above the garden path.

marina.request: I left a phone charger by the bin. Please tell me I put it beside the bin, not in it.
marina.found: The charger is neatly coiled beside the bin.
marina.thanks: Beside it! Incredible. A strong recovery from the rest of my evening.
marina.look: A coiled charger lies beside the bin.

pacific_heights.request: My dog lost a little bell near that planter. Could you look? He keeps trying to pay you in sticks.
pacific_heights.found: You spot the bell caught between the planter and the wall.
pacific_heights.thanks: There it is. He has already forgotten losing it. Must be nice.
pacific_heights.look: Something small glints beside the planter.

twin_peaks.found: A lookout note says: If the view disappears, give it a minute. A sealed trail supply sits under the bench.
twin_peaks.thanks: For a moment, a gap opens in the fog. Then the city puts its blanket back on.
twin_peaks.look: The lookout bench faces the city.

noe_valley.request: Could you check the bike rack for a repair pouch? I keep lending it out and pretending I remember to whom.
noe_valley.thanks: Thanks. I am putting my name on it this time. Very advanced inventory system.
noe_valley.look: A repair pouch hangs from the rack.

mission_bay.found: A lab lunch schedule has been repurposed as a neighborhood potluck list. A care kit is set aside for visitors.
mission_bay.thanks: Someone has added actual vegetables to the potluck list. The neighborhood is evolving.
mission_bay.look: A potluck list is clipped to the bench.

giants_stadium.found: A fan has left a scorecard with a note: First game? Sit near someone who explains things kindly. A sealed supply is beside it.
giants_stadium.thanks: The scorecard has a careful little drawing of the bay in the margin.
giants_stadium.look: A scorecard is tucked near the gate.

financial_district.request: Can you check the bench for my lanyard? I took it off for one normal human lunch and immediately lost it.
financial_district.found: You find the lanyard beside an empty salad box.
financial_district.thanks: Thank you. I can enter a building again. Huge day for access control.
financial_district.look: A lanyard rests beside an empty lunch box.

north_beach.found: A reading list says: You do not have to finish the book to return to the cafe. A little care kit is beside the page.
north_beach.thanks: Someone has underlined one title and added: Talk to me about this one.
north_beach.look: A handwritten reading list is clipped to the bench.

treasure_island.request: Could you check the crane fence for my radio label? Without it, every station is called the windy one.
treasure_island.found: You recover a handwritten radio label.
treasure_island.thanks: Thanks. This one says less windy. We have a sophisticated naming system here.
treasure_island.look: A radio label flutters beside a cable tie.

sutro_tower.found: The tower hums above the trail. A visitor has left a sealed supply and a note: Better reception up here. Same unread messages.
sutro_tower.thanks: The tower keeps humming. You decide the messages can wait another minute.
sutro_tower.look: A visitor note is weighted down near the tower base.

lands_end.found: These foundations once held the Sutro Baths. A small trail kit sits beside a reminder to keep clear of the rough water.
lands_end.thanks: The ruins frame a little piece of ocean. It is louder than you expected.
lands_end.look: The old bath foundations continue toward the coast.

angel_island.found: A summit note says: You made it up here. Eat the snack before the serious part. A sealed supply is tucked under the stone.
angel_island.thanks: The note has a second line: Also, breathe. The summit is not going anywhere.
angel_island.look: A folded note is held down by a summit stone.
